# Environment secrets must never become Cobra flag defaults in help output.
env SKYGO_TOKEN=RECOGNIZABLE_CONTROL_SECRET
skygo --help
! stdout 'RECOGNIZABLE_CONTROL_SECRET'
! stderr .
skygo server --help
! stdout 'RECOGNIZABLE_CONTROL_SECRET'
! stderr .
env SKYGO_TOKEN=

# Malformed and conflicting credential sources fail without echoing content.
chmod 0600 malformed.token wellformed-unknown.token occupied.token original.token unknown-field.json invalid-json.json
! skygo --token-file malformed.token targets list
! stderr '(RECOGNIZABLE_CONTROL_SECRET|SECOND_SECRET)'
! stdout .
! skygo --token-file absent.token targets list
! stdout .
! skygo --token-file malformed.token --token SECOND_SECRET targets list
! stderr '(RECOGNIZABLE_CONTROL_SECRET|SECOND_SECRET)'
! stdout .
env SKYGO_TOKEN=RECOGNIZABLE_CONTROL_SECRET
! skygo --token-file malformed.token targets list
! stderr '(RECOGNIZABLE_CONTROL_SECRET|SECOND_SECRET)'
env SKYGO_TOKEN=

# Unknown JSON field names and malformed syntax can themselves carry secrets.
! skygo auth token list --auth-file unknown-field.json
! stderr 'RECOGNIZABLE_CONTROL_SECRET'
! stdout .
! skygo auth token list --auth-file invalid-json.json
! stderr 'RECOGNIZABLE_CONTROL_SECRET'
! stdout .

# Private outputs refuse overwrites. Failed administration does not overwrite
# an existing secret file or expose its prior contents.
skygo auth init --data-dir $DATA --auth-file $AUTH --token-output admin.token
skygo auth principal add alice --role operator --auth-file $AUTH
! skygo auth token issue alice --auth-file $AUTH --output occupied.token --expires-in 24h
! stderr 'RECOGNIZABLE_CONTROL_SECRET'
cmp occupied.token original.token
! skygo auth init --data-dir $DATA --auth-file $AUTH --token-output admin.token
! stderr '(skygo_[0-9a-f]{32}_|RECOGNIZABLE_CONTROL_SECRET)'

# The real HTTP middleware gives malformed bearer inputs a generic result.
server start
! skygo --token RECOGNIZABLE_CONTROL_SECRET targets list
stderr '^unauthenticated: '
! stderr 'RECOGNIZABLE_CONTROL_SECRET'
! stdout .
! skygo --token-file wellformed-unknown.token targets list
stderr '^unauthenticated: '
! stderr 'RECOGNIZABLE_CONTROL_SECRET'
server stop
! stderr .

-- malformed.token --
RECOGNIZABLE_CONTROL_SECRET
SECOND_SECRET
-- occupied.token --
RECOGNIZABLE_CONTROL_SECRET
-- original.token --
RECOGNIZABLE_CONTROL_SECRET
-- wellformed-unknown.token --
skygo_0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef_AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA
-- unknown-field.json --
{"RECOGNIZABLE_CONTROL_SECRET": "secret"}
-- invalid-json.json --
{"version": RECOGNIZABLE_CONTROL_SECRET}
